mentions.name: Multi-Tenant Forms SaaS (Single Golang Binary)
mentions.description: A multi-tenant SaaS form and checklist product packaged as a single Golang binary with SQLite storage. It is easily self-hostable and can also be operated as a European SaaS (and in other regions) where needed, designed as a low-cost, feature-unpaywalled alternative to form tools charging around 10x more.
mentions.problem: Form-building tools charge high prices (10x more than planned) and paywall advanced features, lacking self-hostability and EU SaaS options.
mentions.audience: users seeking affordable form and checklist tools, including those needing self-hosting or EU-hosted options
mentions.source_excerpt: a multi-tenant SaaS product, that is a single golang binary and stores in sqlite, easily self-hostable but I can also operate it as a European SaaS (and in other regions) where needed
